svg.title: Output of npx @halvorai/ingest demo: an event signed and verified, a sample evidence pack that passes, and the same pack failing after one byte changes
svg.text: $ npx @halvorai/ingest demo
1. Sign an event on this machine
evt_01KDEMO0000000000000000000: Travel booking agent paid Example Airways 412.00 USD on stripe
Instruction sent as sha256:3645911b116c…, never as text
Ed25519 signature: verified
2. Verify a sample evidence pack offline (synthetic data)
PASS: Evidence pack pck_01DEMO00000000000000000000 passed verification.
Manifest: Manifest signature verified
Files: 7 file hashes verified
Events: 3 of 3 event signatures verified
Chain: 3 of 3 included chain positions verified
Anchors: 1 of 1 daily anchors verified
3. Change one byte of events.jsonl and verify again
FAIL: Evidence pack verification failed with 2 issues.
Manifest: Manifest signature verified
Files: 1 file integrity check failed
Events: 2 of 3 event signatures verified
Chain: 3 of 3 included chain positions verified
Anchors: 1 of 1 daily anchors verified
- events.jsonl sha256 does not match manifest
- Event evt_01JA8Q4K3T9V2C7M5N6P8R0S1W canonical sha256 does not match chain.json
Next: npx @halvorai/ingest verify-pack <pack.zip> --jwks <keys.json> checks a real pack.
